name: Katherine Johnson · Follow Hidden Figures
description: Find Katherine Johnson, follow her article's link to Hidden Figures and wait for the linked article to load.
intro: Welcome. We will follow a real link from Katherine Johnson's biography to the film Hidden Figures.

steps.title: Open Wikipedia
steps.say: I enter Wikipedia's address in the blank Chrome tab.

steps.title: Search for Katherine Johnson
steps.say: I type Katherine Johnson into the search field.

steps.title: Open the Katherine Johnson article
steps.say: I click the matching result and open the article.

steps.title: Follow the Hidden Figures link
steps.say: I click the film link in Katherine Johnson's biography and wait for the linked article to load.
steps.wait: Wait for the Hidden Figures article to finish loading.

steps.title: Click the tab's close button
steps.say: I click the close button on the Hidden Figures tab.
